description: This file contains shell functions for platform-specific image checking and upgrade procedures for embedded devices running OpenWrt. It defines functions for checking firmware images, performing system upgrades based on device models, and handling device-specific upgrade steps.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the firmware image for compatibility with specific board types based on their magic number and name.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade procedures tailored to different device models and configurations through case-based logic.
